_readme: Working data structure for one article project. Step 02 copies this file to {project-dir}/article-data.json and populates it from the user's structured brief (see brief-template.md). Later steps read and extend it: step 03 fills brand_perspective; step 06 annotates the outline and allocates research; steps 07-09 draft and edit. Fields below carry empty defaults.

brand_perspective._intent: The organization's or brand's angle on the topic: positioning, differentiators, and how its products or services relate to the subject. Filled in step 03 from the user's brand profile and/or direct input.

article_outline._intent: The proposed article structure the user supplies in their brief, extended with per-section planning notes during drafting.

sections._intent: One H2 section. Supplied by the user's outline; extended during steps 06-07.

research_findings._intent: Compiled research data points allocated to article sections during step 06.

quantitative_stats_library._intent: Optional library of statistics with full source metadata and editorial tracking, if a richer stats pass is run.
